source_statements.source_statement: Create exactly one successor active run for One Time master completion and do not leave two active runs.
Repair the ramble-to-done protocol, validator, schema, resume, next-batch, source coverage, and blocker reporting behavior.
Refresh the master backlog reconciliation before implementation and collapse source statements into canonical executable requirements.
Clean up production Tasks and Decisions so default views are scoped, relevant, deduped, and reversible.
Implement One Time workspace users, roles, role updates, audit logs, relationship enforcement, and negative authorization tests.
Audit every visible action and ensure visible controls work, are disabled with exact blockers, or are intentionally informational.
Correct Operations UI navigation, horizontal filter rails, sticky toolbar, mobile toolbar, buttons, cards, and responsive behavior.
Complete WhatsApp UX using the existing first-party WAPI/Whapi system without sending WhatsApp messages.
Complete Email and Resend UX without live sends, including domain/status readback, webhook code, and one sender/domain Decision.
Complete product, scheduling, booking, parent portal, student portal, provider portal, and billing/access foundations without live charges.
Implement manual Vimeo library workflow now and automated Vimeo upload readiness behind disabled feature flag.
Implement Zoom API client, session workflow, webhooks, and attendance foundation without creating a real class meeting.
Implement transcript privacy with review states, matching confidence, visibility classes, and no cross-child exposure.
Implement server-side event-driven gamification badges with thresholds, idempotency, reversal, audit, and no public individual leaderboard.
Complete community moderation, private questions, parent-visible communication, edit/archive history, reporting, and private-to-public anonymization.
Prepare approved Sefaria source model and disabled study-assistant readiness with scoped retrieval and citation guardrails.
Prepare Option B separate One Time deployment readiness without provisioning paid infrastructure or DNS.
Run final verification, push PR #5 branch, deploy safe bundle, smoke production, and leave only genuine external actions.
Record the product scope: BNA and One Time/Rabbi Ellie Scheller only, not standalone SaaS or generic reseller onboarding.

Use the stated operating priority: privacy/auth, reliable intake, CRM/leads, email campaigns, payment/trial/access, class links, community questions, authenticated support, beta QA, Vimeo/Zoom, then advanced gamification/study bot.

Keep complex setup admin-first and build only essential customer-facing actions such as signup, auth, payment method/cancel renewal, class/library, private/community questions, support tickets, and appropriate progress/communications.
Keep BNA and One Time data private and workspace/relationship-scoped, including tickets, questions, recordings, class links, and transcripts.
Authenticated users may open support tickets through the bot without receiving unrestricted Mishnah study bot access.

Implement configurable warm-lead 30-day trial with card required, $67 monthly renewal, exact renewal date/amount, reminder, one-introductory-trial rule, offer version, and no live charge/bulk send without approval.

Implement configurable referral credit model that activates only after the referred customer completes the first successful paid billing cycle after trial, prevents abuse, and does not apply real invoice credits in this wave.
Record cancellation/refund intent, store policy versions and acceptances, and create one operator Decision for final customer-facing legal wording without blocking test-mode implementation.
Split parent REQ-20260619-306 into child requirements and do not mark the parent complete until all required children are terminal.
Sub-batch 9A must add a first-pass source-envelope classifier so one global keyword does not incorrectly scope every fragment of a mixed source.

Source envelopes must include source metadata, hash, filename/title, channel, upload/source date, uploader, language, default workspace/project/context type, confidence, privacy level, parser version, and processing status.
Title and filename set a strong default context, such as Dratler family meeting, Rabbi Scheller class, Operations ramble, or One Time meeting, while local segments may override it.
Create child requirement for today's class-upload trace.
Create child requirement for Downloads spreadsheet inventory.
Create child requirement for CRM import and deduplication.
Create child requirement for CRM Contacts UX.
Create child requirement for payment-to-access and class-link flow.
Create child requirement for test identities and mock data.
Create child requirement for Agent Mode end-to-end acceptance.
